documents.title: Rajat's resume
documents.text:
GridWatch: Energy Theft Detection System
March 2026
Python, Scikit-learn, Streamlit, Pandas, NumPy, Folium, SQLite, Plotly | Built with Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity
Engineered a real-time monitor applying anomaly detection to 30 days of simulated per-consumer meter data, flagging tampering, bypass
connections and slow-decline fraud with no labelled fraud records.

rule-based systems miss.
Rendered the simulated grid on an interactive map with colour-coded risk tiers, made for offline use. Owned every architectural call, leaning
on AI assistants for speed.
